plugin_desc: Collects key metrics of the Minio object storage system, including runtime status, storage capacity, usage, replication, inter-node communication, and S3 requests, enabling real-time monitoring of storage health, performance optimization, and anomaly detection.
name: Minio

metrics.name: minio_cluster_capacity_usable_total_bytes_gauge
metrics.description: Total usable logical storage capacity after erasure coding, reflecting storage resource scale after redundancy Available from MinIO RELEASE.2021-01-30T00-20-58Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_cluster_capacity_usable_free_bytes_gauge
metrics.description: Available logical storage capacity of the cluster, used for monitoring usage and predicting storage needs Available from MinIO RELEASE.2021-01-30T00-20-58Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_cluster_drive_online_total_gauge
metrics.description: Number of currently online and available storage drives, indicating storage hardware availability Available from MinIO RELEASE.2021-01-30T00-20-58Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_cluster_nodes_online_total_gauge
metrics.description: Number of currently online server nodes, affecting cluster processing capacity and fault tolerance Available from MinIO RELEASE.2021-01-30T00-20-58Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_cluster_health_status_gauge
metrics.description: Overall cluster health status, 1 indicates healthy, 0 indicates unhealthy, providing quick overview of cluster status Available from MinIO RELEASE.2023-08-04T17-40-21Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_cluster_health_erasure_set_status_gauge
metrics.description: Erasure set status (1=healthy), indicating data redundancy set health and directly affecting data security Available from MinIO RELEASE.2024-01-28T22-35-53Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_cluster_health_erasure_set_online_drives_gauge
metrics.description: Number of online drives in erasure set, affecting data availability and redundancy, ensuring redundancy strategy effectiveness Available from MinIO RELEASE.2023-12-23T07-19-11Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_node_cpu_avg_load1_gauge
metrics.description: Average system load over last 1 minute, indicating short-term CPU pressure and performance stress Available from MinIO RELEASE.2023-10-07T15-07-38Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_node_cpu_avg_idle_gauge
metrics.description: Percentage of CPU idle time, indicating CPU utilization, low idle rate may indicate CPU bottleneck Available from MinIO RELEASE.2023-10-07T15-07-38Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_node_mem_used_perc_gauge
metrics.description: Percentage of memory used, indicating memory pressure, high usage may cause performance degradation Available from MinIO RELEASE.2023-12-07T04-16-00Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_node_drive_perc_util_gauge
metrics.description: Utilization percentage of single drive, reflecting storage space usage, important for capacity planning Available from MinIO RELEASE.2023-10-07T15-07-38Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_node_drive_reads_per_sec_gauge
metrics.description: Number of read operations per second on single drive, reflecting read performance and workload Available from MinIO RELEASE.2023-10-07T15-07-38Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_node_drive_writes_per_sec_gauge
metrics.description: Number of write operations per second on single drive, reflecting write performance and workload Available from MinIO RELEASE.2023-10-07T15-07-38Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_node_process_uptime_seconds_gauge
metrics.description: Seconds MinIO process has been running, indicating stability, long uptime indicates stability, frequent restarts may indicate issues Available from MinIO RELEASE.2021-03-26T00-00-41Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_node_process_cpu_total_seconds_counter_rate
metrics.description: CPU time consumed per second by MinIO process, reflecting real-time CPU resource consumption Available from MinIO RELEASE.2021-05-11T23-27-41Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_node_process_resident_memory_bytes_gauge
metrics.description: Resident memory size occupied by MinIO process, reflecting memory usage, monitoring memory leaks Available from MinIO RELEASE.2021-05-11T23-27-41Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_s3_requests_incoming_total_gauge
metrics.description: Number of incoming S3 API requests currently being processed, reflecting current S3 service load Available from MinIO RELEASE.2022-02-12T00-51-25Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_s3_requests_waiting_total_gauge
metrics.description: Number of S3 API requests currently waiting for processing, reflecting S3 service queue backlog Available from MinIO RELEASE.2021-02-23T20-05-01Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_s3_traffic_received_bytes_counter_rate
metrics.description: Data traffic received per second by S3 service, reflecting upload rate and network inflow bandwidth usage Available from MinIO RELEASE.2021-01-30T00-20-58Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_s3_traffic_sent_bytes_counter_rate
metrics.description: Data traffic sent per second by S3 service, reflecting download rate and network outflow bandwidth usage Available from MinIO RELEASE.2021-01-30T00-20-58Z onward (Metrics v2).

metrics.name: minio_s3_requests_rejected_auth_total_counter_rate

metrics.name: minio_node_scanner_objects_scanned_counter_rate
